delete.desc: Deleting this event cannot be undone. Existing registrants will be notified (if automatic notifications are enabled for the event).

cancel.desc: If canceled, the event will remain visible with a canceled status. Registration will halt and existing registrants will be notified (if automatic notifications are enabled for the event).

success.title: Event cancelled
success.message: Existing registrants will be notified if automatic notifications are enabled.

enable.desc: Event canceled (visible with a canceled status).

success.title: Event re-enabled
success.message: Existing registrants will be notified if automatic notifications are enabled.
